name: Dual-Row Opposing Scroll-Coupled Marquee Kinematics
description: Translates vertical scroll position directly into synchronized opposing horizontal motion. Row 1 translates rightward while Row 2 translates leftward using dynamic scroll offsets, passive scroll listeners, and array triplication for seamless infinite looping.
designPhilosophy: Translating vertical page scroll momentum directly into synchronized counter-directional horizontal motion. By coupling two parallel media tiers to vertical scroll position—Row 1 driving rightward while Row 2 drives leftward—the interface produces dynamic parallax tension that feels mechanically driven by the visitor's hand.
appropriateUseCases: Creative portfolio work showcases and client logo strips
Media asset libraries, animation GIF reels, and design system previews
E-commerce brand catalogs and partner rosters
implementationApproach: 1. Scroll Offset Formula: Calculate scroll displacement relative to section entry: offset = (window.scrollY - sectionTop + window.innerHeight) * 0.3. 2. Opposing Translation: Apply CSS transform: translateX(offset - baseOffset) to Row 1 (moving right) and transform: translateX(-(offset - baseOffset)) to Row 2 (moving left). 3. Array Tripling for Infinite Loop: Triplicate image arrays to guarantee seamless visual continuity without visible seam jumps during continuous scrolling. 4. Passive Scroll Binding: Attach passive scroll listener with requestAnimationFrame latching to prevent main-thread scroll locking. 5. Uniform Media Cards: Enforce fixed aspect ratio cards (e.g. 420x270, rounded-2xl) with gap-3 spacing.
performanceConsiderations: Uses passive: true on window scroll and updates exclusively transform: translate3d with will-change: transform, maintaining locked 60fps.
accessibilityRequirements: Provides static horizontal flex overflow with scrollbars when prefers-reduced-motion is active, allowing visitors to inspect cards without kinetic motion.
